``` {r LOGISTIC REGRESSION}

#The following code is for the construction of our mixed-effects logistric regression model. 

library(lme4)

exception_logit = glmer(REC_EXCEPTION_EVER ~ sex + race + age_group + blood_type_dummy + weight_group + diagnosis_dummy +
                          (1 | LISTING_CTR_CODE),
                        data = fortable1, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

exp(fixef(exception_logit))
exp(confint(exception_logit, method = "Wald", parm = "beta_"))

# Or get formatted table
tab_model(exception_logit, 
          show.re.var = TRUE,  # Show random effect variance
          show.icc = TRUE)      # Show ICC

labels_reversed = rev(c("Sex (Ref Male): Female",
                           "Race (Ref White): Black",
                           "Race (Ref White): Hispanic/Latino",
                           "Race (Ref White): Asian",
                           "Race (Ref White): Other",
                           "Age Group (Ref < 1 Year): 1-4 Years",
                           "Age Group (Ref < 1 Year): 5-11 Years",
                           "Age Group (Ref < 1 Year): >11 Years",
                           "Blood Type (Ref Non-O): O",
                           "Weight Group (Ref 25 kg or More): <25 kg",
                           "Dignosis (Ref DCM): CHD",
                           "Dignosis (Ref DCM): Re-Transplant",
                           "Dignosis (Ref DCM): Other"))

plot_model(exception_logit, 
           show.values = TRUE,
           value.offset = 0.3,
           value.size = 6,
           order.terms = c(1:13),
           axis.lim = c(0.5, 10),
           grid.breaks = c(0.5, 1, 5, 10),
           axis.labels = labels_reversed,
           title = "Odds Ratios for Exception Receipt") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 18)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1, color = "black")



library(lme4)
library(DHARMa)
library(car)
library(dplyr)

exception_logit <- glmer(REC_EXCEPTION_EVER ~ sex + race + age_group + 
                          blood_type_dummy + weight_group + diagnosis_dummy +
                          (1 | LISTING_CTR_CODE),
                        data = fortable1, 
                        family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                        control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))


```

``` {r logistic regression model testing}
#The following code is for model assumptions testing


# ===== 1. CHECK OVERALL MODEL FIT =====
# DHARMa residuals
sim_resid <- simulateResiduals(exception_logit, n = 1000)
plot(sim_resid)  # QQ plot and residuals vs predicted
# p > 0.05 = good fit

testDispersion(sim_resid)  # Should be > 0.05
testOutliers(sim_resid)    # Should be > 0.05

testCategorical(sim_resid, catPred = fortable1$sex)
testCategorical(sim_resid, catPred = fortable1$race)
testCategorical(sim_resid, catPred = fortable1$age_group)


sens_exception_logit <- glmer(REC_EXCEPTION_EVER ~ sex + race + age_group + blood_type_dummy + weight_group + diagnosis_dummy + age_group * diagnosis_dummy + (1 | LISTING_CTR_CODE), data = fortable1, family = binomial(link = "logit"), control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))


labels_reversed = rev(c("Sex (Ref Male): Female",
                        "Race (Ref White): Black",
                        "Race (Ref White): Hispanic/Latino",
                        "Race (Ref White): Asian",
                        "Race (Ref White): Other",
                        "Age Group (Ref < 1 Year): 1-4 Years",
                        "Age Group (Ref < 1 Year): 5-11 Years",
                        "Age Group (Ref < 1 Year): >11 Years",
                        "Blood Type (Ref Non-O): O",
                        "Weight Group (Ref 25 kg or More): <25 kg",
                        "Diagnosis (Ref DCM): CHD",
                        "Diagnosis (Ref DCM): Re-Transplant",
                        "Diagnosis (Ref DCM): Other",
                        "Dx * Age (Ref DCM & <1 Year): CHD & 1-4 Years",
                        "Dx * Age (Ref DCM & <1 Year): CHD & 5-11 Years",
                        "Dx * Age (Ref DCM & <1 Year): CHD & >11 Years",
                        "Dx * Age (Ref DCM & <1 Year): Re-HT & 1-4 Years",
                        "Dx * Age (Ref DCM & <1 Year): Re-HT & 5-11 Years",
                        "Dx * Age (Ref DCM & <1 Year): Re-HT & >11 Years",
                        "Dx * Age (Ref DCM & <1 Year): Other & 1-4 Years",
                        "Dx * Age (Ref DCM & <1 Year): Other & 5-11 Years",
                        "Dx * Age (Ref DCM & <1 Year): Other & >11 Years"))

sensitivity_logit = plot_model(sens_exception_logit, 
           show.values = TRUE,
           value.offset = 0.3,
           value.size = 6,
           order.terms = c(1:22),
           axis.lim = c(0.01, 1000),
           grid.breaks = c(0.01, 0.1, 1, 5, 10, 100, 1000),
           axis.labels = labels_reversed,
           title = "") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 18)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1, color = "black")



library(performance)
compare_performance(exception_logit, sens_exception_logit)

summary(sens_exception_logit)


exp(fixef(sens_exception_logit))
exp(confint(sens_exception_logit, method = "Wald", parm = "beta_"))



# ===== 2. CHECK NORMALITY OF RANDOM EFFECTS =====
ranef_values <- ranef(exception_logit)$LISTING_CTR_CODE[,1]

# QQ plot
qqnorm(ranef_values, main = "Q-Q Plot of Center Random Effects")
qqline(ranef_values, col = "red")

# Shapiro-Wilk test
shapiro.test(ranef_values)  # p > 0.05 = normal

# Histogram
hist(ranef_values, breaks = 20,
     main = "Distribution of Center Random Effects",
     xlab = "Random Effect")


# ===== 4. CHECK MULTICOLLINEARITY =====
# Fit without random effects first
logit_no_re <- glm(REC_EXCEPTION_EVER ~ sex + race + age_group + 
                    blood_type_dummy + weight_group + diagnosis_dummy,
                   data = fortable1, 
                   family = binomial)

vif_values <- vif(logit_no_re)
print("VIF values:")
print(vif_values)
# VIF < 5 = good

# ===== 5. CHECK CLUSTER SIZE ADEQUACY =====
cluster_summary <- fortable1 %>% ungroup() %>%
  group_by(LISTING_CTR_CODE) %>%
  summarise(
    n_patients = n(),
    n_exceptions = sum(REC_EXCEPTION_EVER == "Received Exception"),
    exception_rate = mean(REC_EXCEPTION_EVER == "Received Exception")
  ) %>%
  arrange(n_patients)

print(summary(cluster_summary))

# Count small clusters
small_clusters <- cluster_summary %>%
  filter(n_patients < 10 | n_exceptions < 5)
print(paste0("Small clusters: ", nrow(small_clusters), " out of ", 
             nrow(cluster_summary)))

# ===== 6. SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS - EXCLUDE SMALL CENTERS =====
adequate_centers <- cluster_summary %>%
  filter(n_patients >= 10, n_exceptions >= 5) %>%
  pull(LISTING_CTR_CODE)

print(paste0("Adequate centers: ", length(adequate_centers), 
             " out of ", nrow(cluster_summary)))

# Refit model
fortable1_adequate <- fortable1 %>%
  filter(LISTING_CTR_CODE %in% adequate_centers)

exception_logit_sensitivity <- glmer(REC_EXCEPTION_EVER ~ sex + race + age_group + 
                                      blood_type_dummy + weight_group + diagnosis_dummy +
                                      (1 | LISTING_CTR_CODE),
                                    data = fortable1_adequate, 
                                    family = binomial(link = "logit"))

# Compare odds ratios
comparison <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(fixef(exception_logit)),
  All_Centers_OR = exp(fixef(exception_logit)),
  Adequate_Centers_OR = exp(fixef(exception_logit_sensitivity)),
  Percent_Change = (exp(fixef(exception_logit_sensitivity)) - 
                    exp(fixef(exception_logit))) / 
                   exp(fixef(exception_logit)) * 100
)

print("Odds ratio comparison:")
print(comparison)

# Compare variance of random effects
cat("\n=== Random Effect Variance ===\n")
cat("All centers:", VarCorr(exception_logit)$LISTING_CTR_CODE[1], "\n")
cat("Adequate centers:", VarCorr(exception_logit_sensitivity)$LISTING_CTR_CODE[1], "\n")

# ===== 7. CHECK FOR OVERDISPERSION =====
# Already handled by DHARMa plot
testDispersion(sim_resid)  # p > 0.05 = no overdispersion

# ===== 8. CHECK FOR OUTLIERS =====
testOutliers(sim_resid)  # p > 0.05 = no outliers


sim_resid2 <- simulateResiduals(sens_exception_logit, n = 1000)
plot(sim_resid2)

testDispersion(sim_resid2)  # Should be n.s.
testOutliers(sim_resid2)    # Should be n.s.

``` 


``` {r figure 4}
library(emmeans)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

#The following code is for the creation of Figure 3

# Get predicted probabilities with confidence intervals
emm <- emmeans(sens_exception_logit, ~ age_group | diagnosis_dummy, 
               type = "response")
emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm)

# Create publication-quality plot
interaction_plot = ggplot(emm_df, aes(x = age_group, y = prob, 
                   color = diagnosis_dummy, group = diagnosis_dummy)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL), 
                width = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Diagnosis",
                     values = c("Dilated Cardiomyopathy" = "#374e55",
                               "Congenital Heart Disease" = "#df8f44",
                               "Re-Heart Transplant" = "#00a1d5",
                               "Other" = "gray60")) +
  labs(x = "Age Group", 
       y = "Predicted Probability of Exception Receipt") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.position = "bottom")

interaction_plot



emm_pairs <- pairs(emm, by = "age_group", reverse = TRUE) # reverse to get CHD/Cardiomyopathy
summary(emm_pairs, infer = TRUE)

pairs_result <- pairs(emm, by = "age_group")  # reverse to get CHD/Cardiomyopathy
summary(pairs_result, infer = TRUE)  # infer=TRUE gives CIs




```
